relevance_note: The paper ties two ALDH5A1 variants to a dystonia family whose disease column reads 'Succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency (MIM 271980)', so it describes an in-scope person (family DYS-71).
method_note: Read only the paper, schema_ssadh_v5.json and extraction_rules_v1.md. No script was used; table 2 was transcribed by hand and checked against the markdown (repeated merged header cells 'Findings in the established dystonia genes'/'Findings in the uncommon dystonia genes' are section labels, not data rows). Only family DYS-71 has ALDH5A1 variants; every other patient named in the text (DYS-98 IV.3/IV.6, DYS-66 IV.2/IV.5, DYS-4 siblings, DYS-80 II.2, etc.) has variants in other genes and is out of scope, so no rows were made for them. The paper gives no individual patient label, sex or age for DYS-71: it describes the affected family member only through the family label and through the variant rows of table 2, so one individual row was made, labelled 'DYS-71' (the paper's own label for that unit), with family_label_in_paper 'DYS-71'; the number of affected people in DYS-71 is never stated, so the number of individuals is uncertain. is_proband is null (the word proband/index case is never used) and n_patients_reported is null (no patient count for ALDH5A1 is stated). Table 2's 'Disease involvement' column is defined in the table notes as 'OMIM-based information indicating the involvement of the genes in the diseases' (gene-level), and the 'Metabolic findings' column as 'Metabolic findings suggesting the abnormal levels of associated metabolites'; both were recorded for the DYS-71 person because the row is tied to that family. Zygosity 'CH' (defined in the table notes as compound heterozygous) and the pathogenicity cells were taken from the DYS-71 variant rows. variant_type was left 'not reported' for both variants: the paper states no class for them (the 'missense (n=12/17)' sentence is about the established dystonia genes and is a general statement), and the cDNA string was not used to derive a type. No parental testing is reported, so inheritance is 'not reported'. functional_evidence_statement is 'not reported': the urine metabolite measurement is a clinical laboratory finding, not an assay of the variant. No stacked cells (' / ') occur in table 2; table 3 was not used for any row. Features: 'T2 hyperintensity in BG' (basal ganglia, per table note 'BG, basal ganglia') was mapped to the checklist item 'T2 hyperintensity of globus pallidus, subthalamic or dentate nuclei on MRI' as observed - a slight broadening, since the paper does not name the globus pallidus; the same statement and the metabolic cell were treated as group statements naming family DYS-71 (evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'). Counts in table 1 (e.g. 'Cerebellar atrophy 0 / 1 (2.3%)') name no one and were not used. ethnicity_or_country 'Turkey' comes from the cohort statement that the families were recruited in Turkey, not from a per-person statement.
